pages.text: The $(item)Plant Farm$() grows crops, flowers, mushrooms, saplings and trees. It usually needs a $(item)hoe or axe$() plus the plant (and soil) as inputs.$(br2)Its floor is grass, farmland with water, or soul sand, depending on the recipe.$(br2)$(thing)Ingredients$(): 6 glass panes (any), 1 hoe (any), 1 dirt.
Glass panes around a hoe, over dirt.
Put the $(item)soil in slot 1$() and the plant in slot 2. See $(l:easy_farms:plant_recipes/crops)Plant Farm Recipes$() for every plant.
